name: Bafauri
subtitle: steamed chana dal dumplings, the light cousin of the fried snack
prepNotes: Steamed, not fried, which makes it the rare Bihari snack you can eat a lot of.
Grind the dal coarse. A smooth paste steams into something rubbery.

steps.text: Drain the dal and grind coarse with almost no water. It should still have grit to it.
Mix in the onion, green chilli, ginger, coriander, ajwain, turmeric, asafoetida, oil and salt.
Shape into balls the size of a lime with wet hands.
Steam 20 minutes until firm and a skewer comes out clean.
steps.tip: Steam, do not boil. Boiled bafauri falls apart.

steps.text: Rest 5 minutes before lifting them off, and serve with a sharp chutney.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. Re-steam for 5 minutes to soften rather than microwaving, which toughens them.
